items.title: Warren Bernhardt interviewed by Monk Rowe, Bearsville, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: Anthony Jackson was famous because he’d say “flaw” and he’d stop a take... But Anthony wanted it perfect.

ctx.x: I mean unless somebody, obviously, screwed things up, which I often did too. I mean there’s flaws. Anthony Jackson was famous because he’d say “flaw” and he’d stop a take © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

and yell out “flaw.” Whereas he could have just overdubbed it later. But there was 93 guys in the studio, you know, the producer’s going — oh — but Anthony wanted it perfect. He’d change the strings every take.
